description: Shows the user an interactive plan: stages with a checklist and a materials table with the estimate. All texts in the user's language.

calc_input.description: calc_input from prepare_plan, unchanged — REQUIRED for the rooms editor: rooms, sizes and ceiling height are stored with the plan

country.description: ISO country code — needed so the plan can fill in prices itself

default_tier.description: Tier selected by default for all stages

labels.description: Widget text translations for languages without a built-in translation (built in: ru, pl, en, de, uk). Keys come from get_ui_labels.

locale.description: Language of the user's messages (not of the country), any code: en, ru, pl, uk, de, fr, es… Always pass it.

key.description: Material key from prepare_plan (floor_tiles, grout…) — ALWAYS keep it, also when you rename the line to a store name: prices, catalog and recalc find the line by key

pack_size.description: If sold in packs: pack_size — how many calculation units (kg, l, m, m²) are in a pack, pack_price — price of a pack. The plan counts whole packs.

price_min.description: Price per UNIT (per kg, l, m, m²), not per pack

tiers.description: Options by tier: standard, premium, lux. Each — { name, price_min, price_max, store, url }. Option fields replace the main ones when the tier is selected in the plan.

pack_size.description: If sold in packs: pack_size — how many calculation units (kg, l, m, m²) are in a pack, pack_price — price of a pack. The plan counts whole packs.

rooms.description: Rooms (name, area_m2, length_m, width_m, floor, wet) if you have no calc_input

key.description: Stage key from prepare_plan / get_work_order (electrics, walls, bathroom…) — keep it when you translate the name

labor_max.description: Contractor labour cost for the whole stage, to

labor_min.description: Contractor labour cost for the whole stage, from

labor_note.description: How it was calculated, e.g. 45 zł/m² × 120 m²

labor_req_min.description: Mandatory contractor work paid even when DIY (measurements, plumber check, boiler service), from

labor_source.description: Name of the site with rates

who.description: Who does the stage: diy — DIY, pro — contractor. The plan has a switch

tools.description: Tools for DIY work, by stage

have.description: The user said they already have it

key.description: Tool key = the tool name exactly as prepare_plan / get_work_order gave it — keep it when you translate name

user_code.description: User's personal code, if known — applies saved preferences by default

view_id.description: Only if you re-show the same plan
